mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals an impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% annually, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < 0.2pp MoM decline
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS grows by >0.5% MoM and UNRATE declines by >0.2pp MoM, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
